title: Expose recent NO_ALLOCATION causes instead of one opaque LOW_YIELD signal
mission: Extend the existing recent NO_ALLOCATION efficiency window with a durable reason histogram and bounded evidence so GUIDE_RESCATE can distinguish transport truncation, collision exhaustion, explicit claim transport denial, ambiguous transport and capability exhaustion instead of treating all low-yield closures as one mechanism. Preserve historical metrics and the current 10-minute regression window.
definition_of_done: Efficiency runtime derives recent NO_ALLOCATION counts by exact durable receipt reason from the same bounded recent window used by the current regression metric.

At minimum ALLOCATOR_READ_TRUNCATED_*, CLAIM_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED, CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED, CLAIM_TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS and capability-mismatch exhaustion remain distinguishable rather than silently merged.
Historical/cumulative NO_ALLOCATION metrics remain preserved and do not pin the current cause mix.
Guide LOW_YIELD/RESCATE evidence can consume a bounded cause summary and exact recent receipt refs without loading full worker history preclaim.
Regression fixtures cover mixed recent/historical causes and prove no authority or claim semantics change.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
